t: This is the Midland Bank building in the City of London, in the EC4V area. It was designed by Thomas Edward Collcutt, a Victorian architect. Collcutt is known for several important London buildings, among them the Savoy Hotel, Lloyd's Register of Shipping and the Palace Theatre. So when you look at this bank, you're seeing the work of an architect who shaped a good deal of the city's Victorian streetscape. Take a moment to compare it with those better-known buildings if you pass them.
